description: This source file defines the `VertexAIAi21Config` class, which provides configuration for Google's Vertex AI platform to interface with the AI21 API. It extends the `OpenAIGPTConfig` class and includes methods for retrieving configuration parameters and mapping OpenAI parameters to Vertex AI-specific settings.
